name: Institutional Equity Research
description: Evidence-led institutional equity research for listed companies: business and industry analysis, financial statement quality, scenario-based valuation, investment thesis, risks and professional deliverables.
author: Jairo Alonso González

runtime_requirements.python: required for included deterministic calculation and document-generation modules; not required to read the methodology
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external data retrieval
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized provider, API, MCP server, browser or user-supplied dataset
runtime_requirements.file_generation: requires the relevant libraries and a writable runtime

data_dependencies.name: Issuer filings and market prices
data_dependencies.freshness: Verify retrieval timestamp, filing date and reporting period for every invocation

evaluation.environment: Python 3.13.18; isolated remote workbench; CI matrix to be rerun on Python 3.11–3.13
evaluation.report_ref: 31 unit tests passed; synthetic CLI smoke test generated HTML, XLSX, DOCX, PPTX and manifest; HTML semantic layout and visible PPTX branding verified.
limitations: Package tests and synthetic smoke test do not establish financial-domain accuracy, point-in-time integrity, non-US issuer integration or production suitability.
SEC adapter retrieves raw Company Facts and filters by filing date; it is not a universal normalized financial-statement provider.

runtime_compatibility.surface: Included deterministic modules, tests and report generation
runtime_compatibility.evidence_ref: 29 tests passed and CLI smoke test generated four report formats plus verification manifest.

runtime_compatibility.host: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / other agent hosts
